title: Raid on Santiago de Cuba (1662)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Raid on Santiago de Cuba (1662)", at revision 1370706060, opens: "The Raid on Santiago de Cuba took place on 19 October 1662 during the Anglo-Spanish War on the Spanish colony of Cuba. In fear of a Spanish attack on Jamaica, the governor Thomas Hickman-Windsor gaver orders to Royal Navy captain Christopher Myngs to launch a preemptive attack. Myngs' force of fourteen vessels, carrying around 1,400 buccaneers sortied from Port Royal and assaulted Santiago de Cuba. The town despite its strong defences was captured and sacked, resulting in a financial and military success." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q137703855, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1662 raid". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
